profile.name: Rowan Halverson
profile.subline: Product and UX design roles for a December 2026 BFA graduate · Tailored to your resume
profile.recentRole: Lehi SaaS company — Product Design Intern (Summer 2026)
profile.stack: Figma, user research, prototyping, design systems, usability testing, HTML/CSS basics
profile.target: Product or UX designer · Salt Lake City · SaaS
profile.summary: A product designer is adjacent to this board rather than on it: the software companies here (Qualtrics, Lucid, Podium, BambooHR, Filevine) all employ designers, but their listed openings are data and analyst roles. The suggested Utah design employers fill the gap.
profile.applyNow: Apply to the product-design openings at Lucid, Podium and Qualtrics directly from their careers pages; the listed analyst roles here are not for you.
profile.watchLater: Design-intern-to-hire pipelines at the Lehi SaaS companies convert in the spring.
